$comment: The source of sf-code-input's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/code-input (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

x-summary: A one-time code -- from a message, an authenticator, an email -- as a form field with its own value, paste and errors, drawn as the class verification: one native input holds the code (autocomplete one-time-code, so autofill and WebOTP fill it whole) and the cells picture it. Typing fills the next cell, Backspace steps back and clears, a pasted code fills every cell, and each cell is announced by its place.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
settings.length: type string with the numeral default "6" → number (§16 item 29)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-code-input for a one-time code a person types or pastes -- from a text message, an authenticator app, an email -- as a field of a native form.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for a PIN or password the person chooses: that is sf-input with input-type password
Do not submit the form or check the code from the complete event alone: the host checks it
Do not restyle its cells: they are the class verification's, set its public variables
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-code-input label="Код из сообщения" name="code" hint="Мы отправили шесть цифр на +7 900 000-00-00"></sf-code-input>

x-decisions: alias-conflict: the fact is `completed` (sf-code-input-completed), as vocabulary 1.1.5 §9 writes it; the old sf-code-input:complete is its dated same-detail alias. The alias table's earlier sf-code-input-complete was never shipped, so it gets no row.
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases (completed, invalid) are a minor (§4.10).

key-effects: ArrowLeft focus:prev, ArrowRight focus:next, Home to:first, End to:last (the cells), Backspace focus:prev (it clears the cell before the caret and steps back), Tab reach; Delete stays the text box's own editing key, with no effect of the closed list; probe.json drives every declared key (gate 16).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (three of six digits) plus a complete code, alphanumeric, masked, four cells, filled, invalid, disabled and size 2.
css-variables: the seven --sf-verification-* variables of the class sheet sf-code-input draws with, plus --sf-verification-invalid-border-color for the invalid state (§6).
error -> invalid (§17.2): a dated setting alias.
form.validity: value-missing and pattern-mismatch (an incomplete code) from the input, and custom-error (§17.2).
form: the host submits the code through ElementInternals; the input carries no name (§17.1 item 6).
ids: the label, position line and message ids come from the field's instance path (field.base), not the module counter it had (§7.1.1, simai/ui-source#41).
words: digit, character and group are lang runtime words read with sfWord; CODE_INPUT_TEXT stays in code.mjs for its unit tests only.
